i242 | - | kind:question layer:combination cause:doc-gap outcome:docs-answer pr_potential:docs-fix conf:stated depth=full | Water-damaged keyboard: F11+Shift maps to repeated characters. Root: F11 is forwarded before the combination triggers; must also map F11 to disable to suppress it. Combination behavior: base key is always forwarded unless explicitly mapped to disable.
